meta.title: Global Beyond LLC | E-Commerce, Retail & Wholesale in Miami
meta.description: Discover Global Beyond LLC and request the latest product catalog, availability, pricing, ordering, and shipping details directly from our team in Miami.
meta.ogAlt: Global Beyond LLC — Beyond Borders. Beyond Possibilities.

hero.title:
Beyond Borders.
Beyond Possibilities.
hero.lede: Global Beyond LLC is an e-commerce company connecting products, people, and opportunities — through thoughtful selection, clear information, and direct human service.
hero.note: Our selection evolves, so availability, pricing, and shipping details are always confirmed for your specific request.

services.title: Three ways to work with us.
services.lede: Retail, wholesale, and catalog requests — each one answered by a person, not a queue.

items.title: Retail
items.body: Individual orders, handled personally. Tell us what you are looking for and we confirm what is currently available, what it costs, and how it ships.

items.title: Wholesale
items.body: Volume requests reviewed case by case. Share quantities, specifications, and timelines, and we come back with availability and pricing for that request.

items.title: Catalog requests
items.body: Our selection changes over time. Ask for the current catalog and you receive what is genuinely available now — not an outdated page.

process.title: A short, transparent path from question to order.
process.lede: Four steps. The same people with you through all of them.

steps.title: Send your request
steps.body: Write to us with what you need — a product, a category, a quantity, or simply the current catalog.

steps.title: We review availability
steps.body: We check what is in the selection right now and confirm the details that matter for your request.

steps.title: You receive the specifics
steps.body: Availability, pricing, ordering, and shipping details, written clearly, for your request only.

steps.title: We stay with your order
steps.body: From the first message to the delivery details, you keep talking to the same team.

catalog.title: A catalog that evolves.
body: We do not publish a fixed product grid, because that is not how our selection works. What we offer is curated and it changes — new items arrive, others move on.
So instead of showing you a page that might already be out of date, we send you the current catalog when you ask for it, with the availability and pricing that apply on that day.
points: Curated, not exhaustive — we select before we list.
Availability confirmed at the moment of your request.
Pricing, ordering, and shipping details in writing.
One conversation, from question to delivery details.
catalog.photoAlt: Yudenis V. Martínez photographing a product for the current Global Beyond LLC catalog, the camera framing the item on a lit set.
catalog.photoCaption: Photographing what goes into the current catalog.

wholesale.title: Larger orders, reviewed properly.
wholesale.lede: Bulk and wholesale requests are quoted individually. To give you an accurate answer on the first reply, it helps to include:

items.title: Quantities
items.body: How many units, and whether the volume is one-time or recurring.

items.title: Specifications
items.body: Products, categories, variants, or references you already have in mind.

items.title: Timeline
items.body: When you need it, and how flexible those dates are.

items.title: Destination
items.body: Where the order is going, so we can confirm shipping details for it.

about.title: A company you can actually reach.
body: Global Beyond LLC is based in Miami, Florida, and is run directly by the two people who founded it. When you write to us, you are writing to them.
We are early in our growth, and we prefer to say so. What we can promise today is careful selection, clear and honest information, and answers that come from a person who knows your request.
about.photoAlt: Javier Rafael Torres Gil and Yudenis V. Martínez, the founders of Global Beyond LLC, seated in the company's Miami office beneath the Global Beyond logo.

items.title: Trust
items.body: We would rather tell you what we do not have than promise what we cannot deliver.

items.title: Careful selection
items.body: Everything in the catalog is there because we chose it, not because it filled a shelf.

items.title: Transparency
items.body: Availability, pricing, and shipping details are stated plainly, in writing, before you commit.

items.title: Opportunity
items.body: Retail or wholesale, a first order or a recurring one — the door is the same size for everyone.

items.title: Thoughtful growth
items.body: We grow at the pace at which we can still answer every message ourselves.

items.title: Global vision
items.body: Miami is where we are. Connecting products, people, and opportunities is where we are going.

contact.presetHeading: Prefer to start with a ready message?

presets.label: Ask for the current catalog
presets.message: Hello Global Beyond, I would like to receive your current product catalog.

presets.label: Ask about a wholesale order
presets.message: Hello Global Beyond, I am interested in a wholesale order and would like to discuss quantities and availability.

presets.label: Ask about a specific product
presets.message: Hello Global Beyond, I am looking for a specific product and would like to check availability and pricing.
